versions.subject: Sysmon driver altitude change
versions.detection:
selection:
  EventType: SetValue
  TargetObject|startswith: 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\'
  TargetObject|endswith: '\Instances\Sysmon Instance\Altitude'
condition: selection
